name: gnome-gradienttopbar
title: Gradient Top Bar
description: Give the top bar a customizable gradient. Choose direction and colors, and optionally use a different style or keep the theme when windows are maximized.
author: Petar Vasilev <petar@pshow.org>

scripts.docs:states: smcat src/gradient/backgroundTransitions.smcat --output-to docs/background-transitions.svg --direction top-down --dot-graph-attrs 'bgcolor=white pad=0.35 nodesep=0.7 ranksep=0.6 labeljust=l' --dot-node-attrs 'fontname=Helvetica fontsize=14' --dot-edge-attrs 'fontname=Helvetica fontsize=12 color=slategray fontcolor=gray25 arrowsize=0.7'
scripts.local-install: yarn validate-schemas && yarn zip && gnome-extensions install gradienttopbar@pshow.org.shell-extension.zip --force && gnome-extensions enable gradienttopbar@pshow.org
scripts.shexli: .venv/bin/shexli --format json "$PWD/src" | .venv/bin/python -c "import json, sys; report = json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps(report, indent=2)); raise SystemExit(any(finding['rule_id'] != 'EGO-M-004' for finding in report['findings']))"
